Information about a suspected unlawful act and the person committing it must be sent to the competent state authority.

strings.Часть 1 статьи 11 закона № 59-ФЗ предусм: Article 11, part 1 of Law No. 59-ФЗ provides for no reply where a written appeal omits the surname or reply address. If it contains information on a suspected unlawful act and its perpetrator, referral to the competent state body is prescribed.
strings.Часть 1 статьи 11 закона № 59-ФЗ разгран: Part 1 of Article 11 of Federal Law No. 59-FZ distinguishes an individual reply from forwarding information about an alleged unlawful act to the competent authority. Registering receipt, checking risk and potentially forwarding information do not require inventing the author's identity.
